rev: Arizona Joint Tax Application JT-1/UC-001 (12/24), ADOR 10196 (10/26)
notes: Answers: addresses are 'street, city, ST ZIP' and split into the form's boxes; a mailing or owner address abroad puts its province in the county/region box and fills the country box. Dates are written as the form's MMDDYYYY boxes. owner1 and owner2 are 'full name, title, % owned' (the name splits into last, first and middle initial). naics takes up to four codes, comma-separated. tobacco 'Yes, retailer' or 'Yes, distributor' ticks Yes and the kind. 'None' leaves an optional line blank. A1 and the page headers print one box for 'Federal Employer Identification Number or Social Security Number': since the same box takes an SSN, it is left for the signer to write the FEIN. Section B's SSN boxes are never filled. The seasonal filing months, the county and city business codes (D4 and D6), most of Section E (withholding and unemployment wage questions), Section F (acquired business), the second signer, the signatures and dates, and the Section I fee worksheet are left for the applicant.

unmapped.fein: A1 (and the FEIN-or-SSN box in each page header) is one box for 'Federal Employer Identification Number or Social Security Number'. A box that also takes an SSN is never filled by Placetta, so the signer writes the FEIN there by hand.
